title: Consistency Is Not Understanding: Orbit Audits for Neural Field Weight Readers
abstract: arXiv:2611.05798v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recognizing visual content from neural-network weights requires separating functional information from arbitrary parameter coordinates. We audit this separation with hidden-neuron permutations and positive ReLU rescalings that preserve the represented function. The study contains 480 independently fitted shape fields and 1,000 MNIST fields, with transformed copies grouped by origin. On shape recognition, a statistics reader falls from \ShapeRawStats\% to \ShapeJointStats\% accuracy under joint transformations; a normalized set reader retains \ShapeNormSet\% with unchanged predictions. Four small frozen language models obtain \LMRange\% raw accuracy with next-token scoring. A separate four-configuration reasoning experiment with 1,920 scored sessions obtains \FrontRawRange\% raw accuracy with generated answers, while fresh identical raw prompts disagree on \FrontRawRepeatRange\% of origins. translated_title: 一致性并非理解：面向神经场权重读取器的轨道审计
translated_abstract: 从神经网络权重中识别视觉内容，需要将功能性信息与任意的参数坐标区分开来。我们通过隐藏神经元置换以及保持所表示函数不变的正向 ReLU 缩放来审计这种分离。该研究包含 480 个独立拟合的形状场和 1,000 个 MNIST 场，变换后的副本按其来源分组。在形状识别任务上，一个统计读取器在联合变换下准确率从 \ShapeRawStats% 下降到 \ShapeJointStats%；而一个归一化集合读取器则保持 \ShapeNormSet% 的准确率，且预测完全不变。四个小型冻结语言模型通过下一词元打分获得了 \LMRange% 的原始准确率。在另一项包含 1,920 个评分会话的四配置推理实验中，生成式答案获得了 \FrontRawRange% 的原始准确率，然而对相同来源重新使用完全相同的原始提示时，模型在 \FrontRawRepeatRange% 的样本上给出了相互矛盾的判断。规范化使得等价的提示变得……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“轨道审计”方法——利用保持函数等价的隐藏神经元置换和正 ReLU 缩放变换来检验从神经场权重中读取视觉内容的模型，发现现有读取器在等价变换下准确率大幅下降甚至对相同输入给出不一致答案，证明其表面上的输出一致性并不等于对权重所表示函数的真正理解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "orbit audits" using function-preserving hidden-neuron permutations and positive ReLU rescalings to show that current neural-field weight readers suffer large accuracy drops and self-inconsistency under equivalent transformations, demonstrating that their output consistency does not amount to genuine understanding of the represented function.
